fixture_notes: Each mode starts with a fresh shadow instance; direct mode creates no cavity or resolve pass.
Resolved frames execute the actual cavity MRT, shadow resolve, and PBR material lookup in that order.
The deliberately color/depth-invisible blocker is hidden from the override-material camera G-buffer only; it remains an actual source-atlas caster.

Every mode checks all three sources, translated blockers, a moved camera, disabled visibility, a tilted plane, a source-facing curved receiver, a real external blocker, rough metal, and actual Photo light inventory.

A partial source blocker is tested on a pure metal receiver at two roughnesses and two camera directions, plus a diffuse-dominant dielectric, for all three source indices. Resolve mode reads both actual MRT attachments and material F0/roughness independently, and checks that PBR consumes the matching diffuse or specular visibility.
limitations: Finite source sampling and screen interpolation approximate visibility; these checks do not establish equality with path tracing.
The curved reference excludes genuine back-side occlusion and grazing terminators; it does not cover every instrument bevel or concavity.
This isolated scene is not a full-instrument performance benchmark or validation of every GPU/browser.
